annotations.text:
Direction: the site wears the app's own "Herd" system — flat paper, no shadows, no rounded corners, hairline rules, Newsreader over IBM Plex. Colours and type lifted from app/src/styles/tokens.css, not approximated.

The argument: everyone else sells a dashboard. This sells one record that four jobs share.

Everything in [BRACKETS] is a real decision, not a design gap — prices, trial terms, the offline answer, what happens when someone stops paying.

Nothing invented: no fake customer counts, no made-up testimonials, no invented prices. The proof block on the landing page is deliberately empty until you have one real sentence from a real grazier.
